Hi! We're **Primary Pea**, a team competing in the **Women in Data 2026 Datathon** — theme: *What's Cooking*.

We're exploring the datathon's "From Farm to Fork" problem statement using open FAOSTAT data from the UN Food & Agriculture Organization.

Our submission repository goes public when the datathon wraps in September 2026 — watch this space! 🍳
